== Biography ==
Robert was born about 1655.

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Robert Woodsyd. The banns/marriage index records Jean Glasgow and Robert Woodsyd on 13 January 1700 at West Kilbride.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 620/20 / 77; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. Jean Glasgow/Robert Woodsyd 1700 has no compatible proven pair; [[Woodside-936]] was born 1696. The identification remains uncertain.
